validity.researcher_notes: The Producers Midstream website page (Notice of Binding Open Season dated June 30, 2025) describes the Palo Duro Pipeline + Residue Header as a PROPOSED project. The open season ran June 30 - July 14, 2025, and the company targeted an in-service date in Q1 2026, pending FERC authorization under Section 7(c). The project converts an existing 16-inch intrastate pipeline (approximately 275 miles from Nolan County, TX to Wheeler County, TX with gathering header into western Oklahoma) to interstate service. The sheet lists Status as 'operating' updated 2025-10-21, but the cited reference does not confirm operational status as of that date. Need FERC docket or operator disclosure confirming in-service date to verify current status.
